eyebrow: Microsoft Fabric & Real-Time Analytics · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 23 · Real-Time Data Engineering

code:
RawTripEvents
| where fare_amount > 0 and trip_distance > 0
| where VendorID == "2"
caption: Same idea as Foundations Lesson 45's .filter() or T-SQL's WHERE.

eyebrow: project — choosing and renaming, in one step
code:
RawTripEvents
| project VendorID, fare_amount, pickup_time = tpep_pickup_datetime
caption: select() + alias(), combined -- columns not listed are dropped.

eyebrow: extend — adding a column, keeping everything
code:
RawTripEvents
| extend fare_per_mile = fare_amount / trip_distance

# The real KQL equivalent of Foundations' withColumn().
caption: Unlike project, extend keeps every existing column.
